name: menu
summary: The MMenu primitive (a vertical list of selectable icon+label rows, with dividers and danger/positive colours) catalogued in its own right, plus its action-surface usage: the Context/Action menu (FlotoGridActions — a '...' trigger opening an MMenu of actions).
renders: REFERENCE REPRODUCTIONS — the live MMenu needs Ant menu context/theme. Built with real tokens + MIcon.

items.note: [{key,label,icon?,danger?,positive?,divider?,disabled?,selected?}] — JSON string or a JS array property. `icon` is a product icon key (pencil/trash/cog…).

mode.note: context = a ⋯/button trigger opening a top-layer menu of actions · inline = render the menu list in place (the primitive)

trigger.note: context trigger style: dots (⋯ ellipsis-v) · button (labelled)

bordered.note: give the ⋯ dots trigger a border (a bordered kebab button, e.g. the bulk-action-bar More) — 34×34, 1px --border-color, radius 6.

Menu.what: the primitive — a vertical list of selectable rows (icon + label); states: hover (--neutral-lighter), selected (--primary on --code-tag-background-color); MMenuDivider (--border-color); danger (--secondary-red) / positive (--secondary-green) item colours

ContextMenu.source: components/_base-grid-actions.vue (FlotoGridActions) + MDropdown (1x, rich-text editor table options)
ContextMenu.what: an action surface — an MPopover (placement bottomRight) triggered by an ellipsis-v '...' icon, opening an MMenu of ACTION items (icon + label); permission-gated (create/edit/delete keys), supports dividers, danger=red / positive=green

decisionFlow: A list of items to render inside something (nav, picker, dropdown)? -> Menu primitive.
A '...' or button that opens a list of ACTIONS on a row/object? -> Context / Action menu.
Pick a VALUE from options (single/multi)? -> Dropdown picker / Select (not this family).
Go to a destination? -> Navigation (Primary nav / Side menu / Tabs).
do: Reuse the Menu primitive; use FlotoGridActions for row actions.
Colour danger actions with --secondary-red, positive with --secondary-green.
Gate menu items by permission (create/edit/delete keys).
dont: Don't confuse an actions menu with a value picker (use Dropdown picker / Select).
Don't confuse it with navigation (go somewhere).
Don't hand-roll a <ul> dropdown; don't rely on colour alone for danger.

F1.issue: Primitive reproduced (live MMenu needs Ant menu context) -> real tokens + MIcon.

F2.issue: Verify role=menu/menuitem, arrow-key + Esc, trigger aria-label, focus return, non-colour-only danger.

F3.issue: MDropdown appears only 1x (editor); the standard action menu is FlotoGridActions (MPopover + MMenu).

props.createPermissionKeys/editPermissionKeys/: Array of action keys gated by the matching *PermissionName

events.<actionKey>: also emitted by the action's key (e.g. @delete)

ContextMenu.actionItem: { key, name, icon, isDanger|redAction (red), greenAction (green), type:'divider' }

a11y.summary: role=menu + menuitem; ↑/↓ move, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes + restores focus (trapped while open); not colour-only (danger/positive carry icon+label).
issues: The ellipsis-v ⋯ trigger is icon-only — needs an aria-label.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.

menu-primitive.useWhen: You need a vertical list of selectable icon+label rows rendered INSIDE another surface — a nav, a dropdown picker, a side menu, or a custom overlay. Reach for the MMenu primitive (MMenu / MMenuItem / MMenuDivider) as the shared building block; use MMenuDivider to group rows and the danger (--secondary-red) / positive (--secondary-green) item colours for destructive/affirmative rows. States it carries: hover (--neutral-lighter), selected (--primary on --code-tag-background-color).
menu-primitive.dontUse: Don't use the bare primitive when you specifically need a '...' trigger opening ACTIONS on a grid row/object — use the Context / Action menu (FlotoGridActions) which adds the ellipsis trigger and permission gating. Don't use it to pick a VALUE (single/multi) — that's Dropdown picker / Select. Don't use it for navigation to a destination — that's Primary nav / Side menu / Tabs. Never hand-roll a <ul> dropdown to replace it.
menu-primitive.example: The MMenu list that renders the item rows inside the Primary nav, the Side menu, and the Dropdown picker overlays — the same primitive reused across all of them rather than a hand-rolled list.

context-menu.useWhen: You need a '⋯' (ellipsis-v) trigger — or a button — that opens a menu of ACTIONS on a specific row/object: Edit, Duplicate, Delete, etc. Use FlotoGridActions (an MPopover placement bottomRight opening an MMenu of action items); pass the row as `resource`, actions as {key,name,icon,isDanger/redAction,greenAction,type:'divider'}, and gate items via create/edit/delete permission keys. Colour destructive actions red (isDanger/redAction) and affirmative ones green (greenAction), each keeping its icon+label so meaning isn't colour-only.
context-menu.dontUse: Don't use it just to render a static list of rows with no action-trigger — use the Menu primitive directly. Don't use it to select a VALUE from options — use Dropdown picker / Select. Don't use it to navigate somewhere — use Navigation. Avoid the 1x MDropdown pattern (rich-text editor table options) as the standard row-action surface; FlotoGridActions is the standard.
context-menu.example: The '⋯' actions menu on each row of a Floto grid (e.g. an alert/monitor/report list), opening Edit / Duplicate / Delete where Delete is red and the whole item set is filtered by the user's create/edit/delete permissions.

changelog.change: Added a `bordered` option to the ⋯ dots trigger (a bordered kebab button) — used by the obs-toolbar bulk-action-bar More. Default (borderless) unchanged.

changelog: 2026-07-14: completeness pass (owner) — the playground now exposes the `mode` (context | inline) control + a Content preset (Row actions / Nav list) so both modes are switchable on one live menu; added the element 'modes, item shape & when to use' table + item shape ({key,label,icon,danger,divider,selected,disabled}) to the prose spec.

2026-07-11: shipped the real <obs-menu> web component. Two modes: context (a ⋯ ellipsis-v or button trigger opening a top-layer MMenu of ACTIONS — the FlotoGridActions surface) and inline (the MMenu primitive rendered in place). Rows carry a product icon (icon key), danger/positive colours, dividers, disabled + selected states; emits `select` (item key) and reflects el.value. Top-layer Popover menu so it's correct inside animated ancestors. The ⋯ trigger uses the real product ellipsis-v icon.

2026-06-16: Added — the Menu family. Two members: the MMenu primitive (a vertical list of selectable icon+label rows, with MMenuDivider + danger/positive colours) catalogued in its own right as the building block beneath Primary nav / Side menu / Dropdown picker; and the Context/Action menu (FlotoGridActions — an MPopover ellipsis-v trigger opening an MMenu of ACTIONS, an action surface distinct from a value picker). Storybook: Molecules/Menu (Menu + ContextMenu).
